name: Team 1 Plastics
old_description: As a plastic injection molding company for the transportation industry, Team 1 Plastics specializes in precision and clear plastic components which are used in many different systems.
about:
Team 1 Plastics operates from Albion, Michigan, a central Midwestern location that the company says allows easy access for customer molding trials and technical meetings. The founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials, and no founders are named.

The company specializes in precision and transparent plastic injection molding for the transportation sector. Its facility runs 24/7 with a highly automated line: every press is equipped with robots to reduce handling damage and labor costs. Team 1 Plastics emphasizes low mold cavitation — very few tools exceed eight cavities — which it says delivers higher precision and repeatable quality matched to each customer’s annual volume. Beyond molding, it provides value‑added assembly, part consolidation, supply‑chain services (returnable packaging, custom labeling, bar‑code tracking, day/night shipments via its own fleet or customer milk runs), and manages new tool design or transfer tooling bring‑up.

Customers include automotive OEMs and Tier suppliers, as well as manufacturers of oil, fuel (gasoline and diesel), and air filtration systems. The company’s components appear in automobile systems and filtration products across these segments.

Team 1 Plastics states its differentiation rests on a disciplined quality system certified to IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 9001:2015, a zero‑defect mentality supported by cross‑functional corrective‑action meetings, and an Activity‑Based Costing model updated through self‑evaluation and customer feedback. It also highlights a policy of no rush‑order fees for unplanned “drop‑in” orders and a global partner‑vendor network to match each job for best overall value.
